note: Air suit of the four-crew framework. Stays strictly symbolic: thorns, broken antennas, blade-shaped feathers, wind, and storm — never wounds, blood, ropes, or nooses. Cast is reserved away from all 22 Major Arcana species.

suit.name: Swords
suit.coreRule: All subjects anatomically bird; streetwear fitted to bird anatomy; no humanoid forms; no gore. Swords symbolic only — no wounds, blood, ropes, or nooses.

cards.name: Ace of Swords
cards.description: A shrike holds one gleaming blade-feather aloft as storm wind tears past.
cards.pose: Perched high on a glass spire, head raised, one long blade-shaped feather lifted straight up into the gale.
cards.varietyNotes: Suit anchor species. Vertical lone blade-feather against storm reads 'clarity' instantly.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Opens intellect/strategy resources; a clarity card that sharpens later Swords plays.

cards.name: Two of Swords
cards.description: A jay perches between two crossed antennas, eyes shut against the choice.
cards.pose: Balanced at the crossing of two antennas, head level, both eyes closed, wings held tense and even.
cards.varietyNotes: Crested corvid + crossed antennas gives a distinct symmetrical silhouette from the shrike pips.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Stall/standoff effect; locks two units until a choice is forced.

cards.name: Three of Swords
cards.description: A single blade-feather pierced by three thorns in cold driving rain.
cards.pose: Shrike turned aside on a thorn branch, gaze on one of its own feathers caught on three long thorns; no harm shown.
cards.varietyNotes: Sorrow shown through a thorn-caught feather and rain, never injury; the shrike only looks on.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Conditional setback; a unit is pinned/sorrowed but recoverable, not destroyed.

cards.name: Four of Swords
cards.description: A goshawk roosts still in a quiet belfry, its blade-feathers sheathed.
cards.pose: Settled and motionless on a high beam, wings fully folded, three blade-feathers laid flat and sheathed nearby.
cards.varietyNotes: Broad raptor at full rest contrasts the alert pip poses; sheathed blades signal pause, not conflict.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Recharge/recover card; a unit rests a turn to return stronger.

cards.name: Five of Swords
cards.description: A drongo gathers scattered blade-feathers as rivals retreat into the wind.
cards.pose: Sweeping up loose blade-feathers from a ledge, wings spread wide, two smaller birds turning away behind.
cards.varietyNotes: Forked tail and aggressive sweep set the drongo apart; retreat is shown by turned backs, no harm.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Win-but-cost effect; seize resources while giving up board position or allies.

cards.name: Six of Swords
cards.coreMeaning: Transition, moving on, calmer waters ahead
cards.description: Birds ferry across grey storm water toward a clearing, calmer sky.
cards.pose: Merlin leading a small line of birds in low formation over choppy grey water, gale easing ahead toward light.
cards.varietyNotes: Falcon-led ferry crossing toward brightening sky reads 'transition' without any struggle imagery.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Relocate effect; move units to safer ground and reset their state.

cards.name: Seven of Swords
cards.description: A jay slips off with five blade-feathers, two left standing behind.
cards.pose: Creeping along a wire glancing back, five blade-feathers bundled under a wing, two upright feathers left on the ledge.
cards.varietyNotes: Sidelong sneaking jay carrying a bundle is a unique furtive read within the suit.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Steal/skim effect; take resources from an opponent and slip away.

cards.name: Eight of Swords
cards.description: A bird ringed by eight upright antennas, wind-bound — but the cage stands open.
cards.pose: Standing within a ring of eight antennas, wings half-lowered, gap clearly open on one side, gale pressing in.
cards.varietyNotes: Encircling antennas with a visible open gap show self-restriction, not capture; no bindings used.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Self-bind effect; a unit is restricted but can free itself by meeting a condition.

cards.name: Nine of Swords
cards.description: A shrike awake at 3am on a wire, nine pale blade-feathers hanging in the dark.
cards.pose: Perched stiff and wide-eyed on a wire in the night, head low, nine pale blade-feathers floating above in the storm.
cards.varietyNotes: Sleepless wide-eyed shrike under floating pale blades conveys dread through mood, never harm.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Stress/doubt effect; weakens a unit until reassured or supported.

cards.name: Ten of Swords
cards.coreMeaning: Rock bottom, ending that turns to renewal
cards.description: One feather pinned by ten blade-feathers at dawn, a sunrise rising behind it.
cards.pose: A single feather laid on a ledge ringed by ten upright blade-feathers, warm sunrise breaking over the spires behind; bird stirs to rise.
cards.varietyNotes: Ending shown only by ten staged blade-feathers; the rising sunrise lifts it to renewal, not death.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Reset/rebirth capstone; clears the board low but seeds a fresh, stronger start.

cards.name: Fledgling of Swords
cards.coreMeaning: Curiosity, sharp wit, an incoming message
cards.description: The youngest of the Cutting Wind, a sharp blue jay bearing word on the storm.
cards.pose: Bright and alert, mid-hop along a wet antenna, one blade-feather raised like a pen, eyes scanning for news.
cards.varietyNotes: Court Fledgling = youngest, sharp messenger; the crested jay reads quick and clever.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Cheap scout/messenger unit; draws or carries a strategy resource.

cards.name: Outrider of Swords
cards.coreMeaning: Decisive action, swift strategy, charging the idea
cards.description: The Cutting Wind's aerial duelist, a merlin cutting across the storm at speed.
cards.pose: Steep diving flight through the gale, wings swept, a blade-feather streamed forward, motion lines trailing.
cards.varietyNotes: Court Outrider = most aerial duelist; only dynamic diving-flight pose among the Swords courts.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Fast striker; charges across the board to deliver a decisive strategy effect.

cards.name: Matron of Swords
cards.coreMeaning: Clear judgment, hard-won wisdom, inner mastery
cards.description: The inner master of the Cutting Wind, a poised shrike enthroned on a high spire.
cards.pose: Seated upright and still atop a glass spire, head level, one blade-feather held crosswise in calm command.
cards.varietyNotes: Court Matron = poised, inward mastery; the still shrike distinguishes her from the Elder goshawk.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Judgment leader; sharpens and discerns, granting precise control to Swords units.

cards.name: Elder of Swords
cards.coreMeaning: Authority of mind, truth, command of strategy
cards.description: The crew boss of the Cutting Wind, a monumental goshawk ruling the storm-lit spires.
cards.pose: Standing tall and still on the highest spire, wings folded, gaze level over the wind-torn skyline.
cards.varietyNotes: Court Elder = monumental external authority; the broad goshawk is the suit's flagship at full command.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Faction leader; command effects that direct and discipline the whole Swords crew.
